title: Acceptance at a stage
statement: For a sequence $N$ of finite oracle Turing machines with Boolean input symbols, a stage index $i$, and stage data $d$, acceptance means that the $i$th machine, with oracle consisting of the positive strings in $d$, halts on the all-true input of length $	ext{freshLen}(i,d.	ext{bound})$ within $	ext{freshLen}(i,d.	ext{bound})^i+i$ steps and outputs the one-symbol string $[\mathrm{true}]$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequence of finite oracle Turing machines over Boolean symbols
